headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty closed lower as surging crude oil prices and global market concerns weighed on sentiment.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 26 October.

why: Surging crude oil prices approaching $114 per barrel weighed heavily on Indian equities.
Weak global market cues as US indices fell amid persistent AI doubts ahead of the Fed meeting.
Profit-booking dragged the market lower, with Sensex shedding over 1,600 points during the trading week.
Mixed Q2 corporate earnings reports and guidance cuts impacted investor sentiment.
whatHappening: Infosys reported a 6.2% rise in Q2 net profit to ₹7,828 crore but cut its FY27 revenue guidance.
BPCL rebounded into profitability, posting a Q2 net profit of ₹4,993 crore.
Coforge reported strong Q2 performance with net profit surging 56.5% to ₹588 crore.
Godrej Properties saw its Q2FY27 net profit decline 62% to ₹154 crore.
summary:
On the last trading session, Indian markets declined with Nifty ending around 22,600 as high oil prices and weak global cues pressured stocks.
Key earnings disclosures showed strong profit growth for BPCL and Coforge, while Infosys lowered its FY27 guidance.
Trading remains suspended for the weekend and will resume on Monday, 26 October 2026.
